title: Production Draftsperson
screening_questions: Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
How many years' experience do you have as a Production Draftsperson?
How much notice are you required to give your current employer?
rationale: Melbourne production drafting role using Revit; Marc has coursework Revit.
Residential volume drafting rather than civil infrastructure design.
Advert requires at least 3 years as a production draftsperson.
caution: Essential 3+ years production draftsperson experience in volume or custom residential building; intermediate to advanced Revit.
mandatory_unmet: At least 3 years demonstrated experience as a production draftsperson in volume or custom residential building
employer_line: Goldstate Homes in Wheelers Hill prepares production and working drawings in Revit for investment homes, dual occupancies and related residential products.
